trial_court: Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Kangra at Dharamshala
case_name: Manisha Rana And Another vs Monika And Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Manisha Rana and another (brother and sister of proforma respondent No.2)
parties.respondent_defendant: Monika and others (proforma respondent No.1, her husband Manuj Katoch, and others)

facts_of_case: Respondent No.1 filed a private complaint under Section 606 IPC for recovery of istridhan against proforma respondent No.2. The present petitioners are the brother and sister of proforma respondent No.2 who were not served in the private criminal complainant.

legal_principles.principle: To lodge a proper complaint, mere mention of the sections and language of those sections is not the be all and end all of the matter.
legal_principles.held: What is required to be brought to the notice of the court is the particulars of the offence.
cited_cases: Neelu Chopra and another vs. Bharti, (2009) 10 SCC 184

legal_principles.principle: To make out an offence under Section 406 of the IPC, two ingredients need to be satisfied conjointly: entrustment and misappropriation/conversion to use.
legal_principles.held: Two ingredients need to be satisfied conjointly (a) entrustment and (b) misappropriation/conversion to use of the accused to the detriment of the person who had entrusted it.

use_for_drafting: drafting land acquisition cases in Himachal Pradesh
preparing private complaints for recovery of istridhan
